title: Designing Sustainable Federated Learning as a Service using Neural Architecture Search
abstract: arXiv:2608.14359v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The sustainability constraints of FLaaS consumers pose significant challenges to maintaining carbon-feasible federated training in FLaaS environments. These constraints often lead to infeasible consumer participation and unstable federated training under hard carbon constraints. We propose a Sustainable Federated Learning as a Service (SFLaaS), a carbon- constrained Neural Architecture Search (NAS) framework for heteroge- neous sustainable constraints. We introduce a requirement-driven search space that transforms consumer sustainability profiles into a feasible architecture region before federated execution. We develop a consumer-level carbon feasibility estimation mechanism to evaluate candidate architectures under dynamic carbon conditions. We propose a sustainable con- sumer scheduling strategy that adaptively selects feasible consumers and allocates local workloads to preserve consumer participation and statistical data coverage. An

translated_title: 设计基于神经架构搜索的可持续联邦学习即服务
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.14359v1 公告类型：新 摘要：FLaaS消费者的可持续性约束对在FLaaS环境中维持碳可行的联邦训练构成了重大挑战。这些约束常常导致在严格碳限制下消费者参与不可行和联邦训练不稳定。我们提出了一种可持续联邦学习即服务（SFLaaS），这是一个针对异构可持续性约束的碳受限神经架构搜索（NAS）框架。我们引入了一个需求驱动的搜索空间，在联邦执行前将消费者可持续性概况转换为可行的架构区域。我们开发了一种消费者级碳可行性估计机制，以在动态碳条件下评估候选架构。我们提出了一种可持续消费者调度策略，该策略自适应地选择可行消费者并分配本地工作负载，以保持消费者参与和统计数据覆盖。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于神经架构搜索的可持续联邦学习框架，通过需求驱动搜索空间、碳可行性估计和自适应消费者调度，在严格碳约束下实现稳定的联邦训练并维持消费者参与。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a sustainable federated learning framework based on neural architecture search, which achieves stable federated training under strict carbon constraints and maintains consumer participation through requirement-driven search space, carbon feasibility estimation, and adaptive consumer scheduling.
